column1: 622a91|Which part is the robot's "brain", which runs the program you wrote?
a94c60|Brain
42b0b1|Controller
1c9a53|Smart Motor
392257|Distance Sensor
69517c|The Brain is the main unit, and the program is downloaded into it to run. The Controller is for driving by hand.
2384f6|You want the robot to know how far away the wall ahead is. Which sensor should you use?
80a5b7|Gyro
46783c|Bumper Switch
ec8475|Color Sensor
57f248|The Distance Sensor measures the distance to the object ahead. The Bumper only knows after you hit something, and the Gyro measures how many degrees you've turned.
85d9b9|What is the Controller mainly used for?
f4bff5|Storing programs
3ca94d|Letting a person drive the robot by hand
970d58|Measuring distance
5eea14|Charging the robot
cbfd8d|The Controller lets the driver operate by hand; the autonomous period relies on a program written beforehand and downloaded to the Brain.
b3457f|Which "sensor → what it measures" pair is correct?
6ca208|Gyro → how many degrees the robot has turned
119d63|Bumper → distance ahead
91aacb|Color Sensor → motor speed
a95a9a|Distance Sensor → whether a switch is pressed
74e054|The Gyro measures angle / heading. The other three are mismatched: the Bumper detects presses, the Color Sensor detects color, and the Distance Sensor measures distance.
3aa23b|How many Smart Ports does a VEX IQ 2nd-generation Brain have?
119214|The 2nd-generation Brain has 12 Smart Ports, where motors and sensors plug in.

a598a7|Nothing; the program finds it by itself

8a7893|Move the motor to port 1 instead
0b414e|Reinstall VEXcode
ea2748|The program needs to know which port a device is on, so the port numbers in Devices must match the actual wiring.
6252c1|The left and right motors are mounted facing opposite directions, but neither is set to Reverse. When you run "drive forward", what will the robot most likely do?
92983e|Drive forward normally
24be2d|Spin in place
96ee13|Not move at all
6fad7f|Drive backward
ff2812|Because the two sides turn in opposite directions, one side pushes the robot forward while the other pushes backward, so it spins in place. Fix: set one side to Reverse.

f4d0d0|Whether the cable is plugged in firmly and whether the port number matches the program's settings
7f6b69|Swap in a new Brain
6b87e2|Rewrite the whole program
de9272|Debug from the simplest, most likely cause first: wiring and settings.

9e1a8d|Download the program to the Brain
5e99f8|Just press save on the computer
c851de|Press any key on the Controller
95f807|Connect to the internet
253535|You must download it to the Brain first; only then does the program exist on the robot.

b23542|No difference
639d6d|The motors get weaker and behave unstably
512a9b|It runs faster
61f060|The program fixes itself

eb77c3|No problem, just use it tomorrow
c61a11|Charge it fully, and note the charging time in your notebook

6edf79|Switch to a new program

29f12d|The triangle

1fa503|The battery is too full

d918d3|Motors use less power
e4068b|Sensors can only read that way

b0d057|One wheel circumference
318c61|One wheel radius

4a0c2e|It depends on the motor's color

de2a70|Distance = turns × circumference = 3 × 200 = 600 mm.

a39f22|turns

627361|Circumference = 60 × 3.14 = 188.4 mm; turns = 942 ÷ 188.4 = 5 turns.
dcf60a|When a small gear drives a big gear, the big gear's speed will be:
2f3ddd|Slower, but with more force
23d9b0|Faster, and with more force
2f0d10|Exactly the same
28f887|Faster, but with less force
145a49|Small drives big = reduction: trading speed for force. The reverse, big driving small, is a speed-up.
dc4930|A 12-tooth gear drives a 36-tooth gear. When the 12-tooth gear turns 3 times, how many times does the 36-tooth gear turn?
d9a0ea|Driven turns = 3 × 12 ÷ 36 = 1 turn. (It has 3 times the teeth, so it turns 3 times slower.)
f4a3eb|Two meshing gears turn in:
361339|The same direction
e24d69|Opposite directions
b06f8d|Depends on size
a2d641|The same, then opposite
55473f|Two meshing gears always turn in opposite directions.
ae5669|A 36-tooth gear drives a 12-tooth gear. When the 36-tooth gear turns 2 times, how many times does the 12-tooth gear turn?
f6a742|Driven turns = 2 × 36 ÷ 12 = 6 turns (a speed-up with less force).

4262b7|Left wheel forward, right wheel backward
f8c0b8|Both wheels forward
9a6e6b|Both wheels still
2daba3|Left wheel backward, right wheel forward

d9a483|Veers right
df765d|Veers left
febe02|Still goes straight

41a6c1|It can only turn forward
1ae1bf|It can slide sideways and has less resistance when turning in place
f465f6|It's always slower
2cb440|It needs no motor
e88028|An Omni Wheel has small rollers on its edge, so it slides sideways and is less likely to catch when turning.

e10997|Half
cd1442|Twice
4eaac7|Four times
da771e|With twice the angle, the arc each wheel travels is also twice as long.

759019|Use a speed-up to make it spin faster
f91665|Remove the motor
775ec7|Make the arm thinner

d65996|When a claw grips a ball, why is a rubber surface better than smooth plastic?
6c6fbd|It's lighter
c0e72b|More friction, so the ball is less likely to slip
57e898|It's cheaper
fad9c4|The more friction, the steadier the grip.
c5b737|When the same object is lifted at the end of a longer arm, it is:

2ca4a9|Harder
e1e5fc|Depends on color

9fec8f|Confirm what to grab and what the requirements are
0c228a|Think of several options and sketch them
e2bc05|Build a prototype
8c0749|Test and record the results
b0e500|Improve based on the results
